caption:
which spot does your sunscreen miss?

Often, it's the eyelids — especially the inner corner, next to the nose.

Check yours: put sunscreen on the way you always do, then close one eye in a mirror. Look at the lid and that inner corner.

In a UV camera study of 57 people, about 14% of the eyelid area was missed, compared with 7% of the rest of the face. After people were given a reminder, eyelid coverage improved, but the inner corner was still often missed. In a second study, people didn't realise they had missed anything.

Cream near the eyes can sting, so this is where sunglasses that block UV earn their place.

Skin Test #10/30 from a doctor in Seoul. Follow for #11: does the SPF in your moisturizer count?
